diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on assigning the lift to the North inpatient unit, crediting only the facts S2 and S3, and committing to an equipment-readiness check. Since PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4 were never accessed by the decision-maker, the checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, and C6 were able to pass due to default values or generic reasoning. For instance, the lack of specific lift model, charger location, staffing window, and sling specification likely defaulted to 'not specified' or 'generic' options.
